summary: Example showing how to print the decrypted contents of /etc/foo.txt with the unvault lookup, converting it to a string and trimming whitespace.
questions: How do I display the decrypted contents of a vaulted file in a debug message?
Why should I pipe the unvault lookup output through string and trim?
What does a basic unvault lookup example look like?

answer_card.title: Example: show a vaulted file's contents
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "the value of foo.txt is {{ lookup('ansible.builtin.unvault', '/etc/foo.txt') | string | trim }}"
```
The lookup returns bytes, so `| string | trim` turns it into clean text.
